<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Context brief. Purpose: extend the verified phase-1 prep (d800949) to every catalogued harness and ship research recipes. Contract: unchanged core::prep v2 (guide v3 architecture.contracts); prep harness key = adapter catalogue descriptor id; each fold's pattern = the descriptor's session_glob. Entrypoints: new PrepFold impls in crates/adapter-{omp,pi,codex,copilot-cli,vscode-copilot,cursor}/src/prep.rs, SnapshotPrepLoader in crates/loader-snapshot/src/prep.rs, recipes in crates/cli; bindings only in crates/app/src/prep.rs. Dependencies: guide v3 sealed on the phase-1 composition; seven lanes run in parallel clones and import no sibling implementation; tk-000e imports tk-000c, then the folds, then tk-000d. Test approach: folds on synthetic fixtures (existing adapter fixtures are a starting point) through PrepFold alone, with batch-split and checkpoint-resume equivalence; loader on temp JSON/journal/SQLite files; CLI with its fake PrepApi and static recipe checks; assembled behaviour through unisphere-proof prep. Hazards: dialect gaps (Codex model, VS Code/Cursor IDE usage absent from the query mappings), Cursor IDE many-sessions-per-database, snapshot size limits, SQLite WAL, descriptor-id keys, content leakage. Required proof: vd-000d…vd-0014, vd-0008, vd-0015, vd-0017, vd-000b, vd-000c.
